newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 38-19.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 38-19.

text.p: Australian Capital Territory (ACT) beat Northern Transvaal 38-19 (halftime 8-5) in a Super 12 rugby union match at Bruce Stadium on Friday.
ACT Brumbies - Tries: Joe Roff (3), Troy Coker, Mitch Hardy. Conversions: David Knox (2). Penalties: David Knox (3).
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Jannie Brooks, Jacques Olivier, Kosie Van Vuuren. Conversions: Theo Van Rensburg (2).
